definitions.explanation: A formal name or title used to refer to a person, place, or thing. More formal and official than ordinary naming. Often used in institutional, academic, or regulatory contexts when discussing what something is officially called.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な{呼称|こしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{役職|やくしょく}→役職：05514_yakushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呼称|こしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The title of this position was changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{呼称|こしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{国際的|こくさいてき}→国際的：06457_kokusaiteki⟧な⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Since the same product can have different designations in different countries, international standardization is being called for.

notes:
USAGE:
{呼称|こしょう} is a formal word used for official or institutional names and titles. It is more formal than ⟦{呼|よ}び{方|かた}→呼び方：12125_yobikata⟧ (casual way of calling) and ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ (name). Common in bureaucratic, academic, and business writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧{呼称|こしょう}: official designation
- {呼称|こしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the designation
- {呼称|こしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧: to have different designations
- ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧な{呼称|こしょう}: common designation
